gloss: to stand stock-still; to stand around idly

definitions.gloss: to stand stock-still; to stand around doing nothing
definitions.explanation: To stand rigidly in one place, usually without doing anything, out of surprise, confusion or idleness. Often critical: ぼーっと{突|つ}っ{立|た}ってないで (don't just stand there).

examples.japanese: {入口|いりぐち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{突|つ}っ{立|た}つ。
examples.english: To stand stock-still in the doorway.

examples.japanese: {突|つ}っ{立|た}ってないで⟦{手伝|てつだ}って→手伝う：00898_tetsudau⟧。
examples.english: Don't just stand there, give me a hand.

examples.japanese: ⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦したら→する：00392_suru⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{分|わ}から→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧ず、⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ただ→ただ：01613_tada⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{真|ま}ん{中|なか}→真ん中：00968_mannaka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{突|つ}っ{立|た}って⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Not knowing what to do, he just stood there in the middle of the room.

notes:
{突|つ}っ- (an intensifying prefix) + ⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧ (to stand). Informal, and usually in the て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ form for someone standing idle.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦ぼーっと→ぼーっと：05269_bootto⟧{突|つ}っ{立|た}つ: to stand there absent-mindedly
- {突|つ}っ{立|た}ってないで: don't just stand there
- ⟦{呆然|ぼうぜん}→呆然：17758_bouzen⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{突|つ}っ{立|た}つ: to stand dumbfounded

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{立|た}ち{尽|つ}くす→立ち尽くす：31668_tachitsukusu⟧: to stand rooted to the spot, more literary and often from shock or emotion
- {棒立|ぼうだ}ち: standing stiff as a pole
